sessionWitness.fixtureGap: The prior seed search required Copperskiff only in the South opening hand. GameSession filters legalNorthDeployments against the North hand before asking OpponentController for a proposal, so a seed without North Copperskiff could never create a North unit. The prior report did not capture the selected seed or opening hands, so it cannot establish whether that exact seed lacked North Copperskiff.

browserRestorePath: Restore the witness bytes with GameSession.restore in the arena iframe.
Mount mountShippedGameBrowser on a detached staging root and serialize its browser snapshot.
Pass that snapshot to the existing arenaHudController.restore method, which restores the loop graph and renders it.
Compare the controller's serialized GameSession bytes with the exact source witness bytes before stepping.
sourceContractAudit.markerContract: bindCombatViewModel creates each marker from projected battle entities, sets data-kind from entity.kind (the GameSession unit archetype ID) and data-side from entity.side, and creates Copperskiff art as .combat-art--copperskiff.
sourceContractAudit.failureInterpretation: The one-case run persisted exact source/restore bytes, units, markers, computed style, console state, and a screenshot. Both source and restored GameSession units were empty at tick 0; after 120 ticks only the South Copperskiff existed and its real DOM marker was visible. LiveBattle retains unit records instead of removing killed units, so the North Copperskiff was never spawned in this fixture. This identifies a fixture precondition gap, not a renderer disappearance.

integrationVerdict: The corrected pinned-main actual-game run records eight scenario cases and the terminal restart witness. It verifies initial witnessed GameSession restoration, reciprocal headings, both team markers, contact/damage, reduced-motion rendering and measured bounds in all cases. Live checkpoint screenshot equality is verified only for phone/390x844/normal/horizontal. Byte-exact browser input bridge/audio continuation restore and post-checkpoint continuation across all eight cases remain unverified; independent visual review remains outstanding. No whole-piece adoption or visual PASS is claimed.
